evidence: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile. It pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (judge CLI, l.17), @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (l.19), express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (l.20-21, the app's only npm deps per solution/app/package.json and server.js requires; also the agent image's only global npm deps), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (l.31), installs Playwright's chromium with deps into /opt/playwright-browsers and symlinks /usr/local/bin/chromium (l.33-38), and carries Node 22 from node:22-bookworm-slim plus python3.12 for restart_mcp.py/score.py (stdlib-only imports). Measured on 2026-10-09: docker build of the frozen tests/ succeeded; in the container node v22.23.2, Python 3.12.14, claude 2.1.281, harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 (with the codex bypass patch present), playwright-mcp and rewardkit on PATH, chromium -> chromium-1237. The golden installed via solve.sh started exactly as test.sh does (env -i, setpriv uid 65534, DB_PATH, cwd /tmp) and answered 200; Playwright launched /usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox and rendered the page (title 'Kittle & Rowe · Matter chat'); restart_mcp.py answered MCP initialize; all judge.toml mcp_servers commands (playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium, /usr/local/bin/python3) exist in the image. Counterexample search: a conforming app shipping extra native npm deps in /app/node_modules is carried as an artifact and the verifier glibc (trixie 2.41) is >= agent glibc (bookworm 2.36), so it still loads; a broken app cannot pass by virtue of this row (it only concerns image capability). Minor notes: base images are tag-pinned not digest-pinned and apt is unpinned (template-controlled; NOTE per deterministic C11). Risk=true only because no full configured rewardkit + claude-code/OpenRouter grading run on these exact bytes exists in raw-evidence-index (hosted runs are of previous v2 bytes; golden run used cw-editor-verifier:current), so end-to-end 'grade' is inferred, not measured for this candidate.
